BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.

2. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

9. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.

10. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.

14. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
